Calendar: the PPL policy refers to 'the time between fall and spring semesters' (semester calendar, length not stated) -> calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Member described (U8): a nine-month, academic-year tenure-stream faculty member with two years of service, FMLA-eligible (12 months, 1,250 hours). For nine-month appointees, PPL is taken within the first six contractual months; a birth in the non-contractual period (typically 15 May - 14 Aug) starts eligibility with the new contractual period; holidays and breaks are paid as holiday pay rather than PPL days.
U8 path recorded in a note, not a component: pregnant faculty not eligible for FMLA receive time off under personal leave (4.5.1) without the one-year service requirement (noted on c2).

Not components (cannot be used for a birth or adoption, or not leave): sabbatical leave (4.4, research plan), educational leave (4.5.4), military leave (4.5.3), holidays and personal holidays (4.1), external-activity limits. Vacation: twelve-month faculty accrue 22 days/year (max 44); nine-month faculty accrue none since August 2013 (noted on c3, the own-accrual component). The pre-September-1993 sick-time coverage note in 4.3 applies only to faculty employed before 1993 and is not coded.
